prompt: Which kinds of AF table exist? Select all that apply.
explanation: AF tables can be internal, imported or linked. "Archived" is not an AF table kind.

prompt: What is the best-practice size limit for an internal AF table?
explanation: Best practice is to keep an AF table under 10,000 rows, because internal tables are loaded into each client's memory.

prompt: True or false: since PI 2014, the 10,000-row guideline still applies to linked (external) tables queried with parameters.
explanation: False. Since PI 2014 the guideline no longer applies to linked tables, because a parameterised query is resolved on the server rather than loading the whole table into the client.

prompt: An analysis output in MW is mapped to an attribute in MWh. Will AF convert it?

options.text: Yes, AF converts any two units
No, AF converts only between units in the same UOM class
Yes, if the Display UOM Group is Metric

explanation: AF converts UOMs only when both units are in the same UOM class. Power (MW) and energy (MWh) are different classes, so no conversion happens.

prompt: Why should you avoid defining two UOMs whose abbreviations differ only by case, such as MW and mW?

options.text: AF treats UOMs and abbreviations case-insensitively, and uniqueness is enforced across the whole UOM database
PI Vision cannot show lower-case units
Lower-case abbreviations are reserved for US Customary

explanation: AF treats UOMs and abbreviations case-insensitively, and uniqueness is checked across the whole UOM database, not per class. So MW and mW would clash.

prompt: In PSE, the Display UOM Group (for example Metric or US Customary) is set under Tools > ____.
explanation: The Display UOM Group is set in PSE under Tools > Options.

prompt: What should the engineer know before adding it?
scenario: An engineer working in AF database 'Site A' wants to add a custom UOM 'decimeter' (0.1 m) to class Length for one report.

options.text: It will be visible only in Site A
The UOM database is shared, so the unit appears for every AF database on the server
It must be added to SQL Server directly

explanation: Custom UOMs such as decimeter (0.1 m) can be added, but the UOM database is a single repository shared by all AF databases on the server.

prompt: Match each UOM term to its meaning.

pairs.right: A family of convertible units, such as Volume or Density
A display preference set such as Metric or US Customary
The single store of units shared by all AF databases on a server

explanation: Classes define convertibility, groups define display preference, and the UOM database is server-wide.

prompt: True or false: exporting an AF database with 'All Referenced Objects' includes the UOM database.
explanation: True. An export with All Referenced Objects includes the UOM database, so the target server gets the units it needs.

prompt: Where is time-zone handling for an AF table's data configured?

options.text: On the table, in PSE under Library > Tables
In the PI Data Archive tuning parameters

explanation: Time-zone handling for table data is configured on the table itself in PSE (Library > Tables).
